caption: The drawing depicts three views of a single bottle rendered in shades of light blue, giving it a glass-like appearance. The uppermost view is a side profile showing the bottle's oval shape and textured surface with leaf-like or feathered patterns along the body. Below, there are two front-facing views of the bottle. The left-front view displays an embossed eagle clutching arrows in its talons, surrounded by inscriptions reading "ZANESVILLE," "OHIO," and "SHEPARD." The right-front view shows the bottle’s reverse side decorated with an arched structure supported by two columns and a bundle of arrows or sheaves set within the arch, with additional ornamental scrollwork at the base. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, allowing the details and color of the bottle to stand out.
title: Flask
